items.full: I believe companies should offer employees more opportunities to learn new skills. The main reason is that technology changes quickly, so regular training helps employees stay effective. For instance, our team recently introduced a new digital system. At first, several coworkers found it difficult to use. After a short training session, we learned the key features and completed our tasks much faster. As a result, we made fewer mistakes and worked more confidently. Training also makes employees feel that the company supports their growth. Although training takes some time and money, I think the long-term benefits are worth the investment.
